notes_for_editor: The gone status rests on the FFLOS Wisconsin list alone, with no removal date. The 2015 DNR decision covers all 72 state towers, but no source read names Goodman in it, so the story presents it as context only. Do not confuse with Goodman (McElhany), Newton County, Missouri, which is on centraluslookouts and in data/raw/central_us_lookouts/goodman.html; that is a different tower. The WHS record for the Goodman Ranger Station (W 15148 US Highway 8, HI22680) describes a 1936 WPA station and names no lookout, so it is not used. The FFLOS detail page is not in the crawl cache.
